title: State-contingent sovereign debt: payment dominance, exact comparability and implementable bounds
description: Unrefereed Evidence Press research release. For fixed old claims, positive discount factors and piecewise-affine new service, a declared three-coordinate comparability screen reduces on each reachable trigger region to affine present-value and programme-service tests plus a quadratic duration test. Exact examples show that componentwise smaller payments can fail the duration veto; scalar design gives complete payment intervals under partial information; and a nonproportional oblique-trigger family has sharp implementable caps of 25 and 110/7 with binding switch 75/7. The public package includes the complete manuscript, accessible versions, exact rational certificates, an independent low-dimensional checker, negative controls and a whole-package manifest. Exact replay is not formal verification, legal authentication, empirical validation, external peer review or a country-level assessment.
